accounts.manualInjectHint: Log in to chat.qwen.ai first, then press F12 to open DevTools, go to Application / Storage, find the token in Local Storage and paste the full raw value into the box below.
accounts.manualInjectWarn: Important: only paste the raw token value from Local Storage, do not extract it from Network requests or the Authorization header.
accounts.manualInjectWarn2: Do not include the Bearer prefix, and do not paste the whole Authorization text. Email and password are optional; the system verifies the token before injection.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage console authentication and gateway runtime configuration.
settings.fetchError: Failed to fetch config, please check session Key
settings.concurrencySaved: Concurrency config saved (effective at runtime immediately)
settings.poolSaved: Warm pool config saved (effective on next refresh round)
settings.jsonError: Invalid JSON format, please check syntax
settings.sessionKeyDesc: Paste an existing API Key here; the console will use it for all management operations. (Stored in the browser locally)
settings.sessionKeyPlaceholder: sk-qwen-... or default admin key admin
settings.coreDesc: Runtime concurrency slots and queue thresholds (must be changed in backend config.json and restarted to take effect).
settings.maxInflightDesc: Requests each upstream account handles simultaneously. Too high risks bans, too low underutilizes.
settings.globalMaxDesc: Hard cap on total in-flight requests across all accounts. 0 = unlimited. Corresponds to the Dashboard "Async tasks" peak.
settings.poolDesc: Pre-build chat_id to avoid the upstream /chats/new handshake (0.5~6s). Runtime changes take effect immediately.
settings.poolTargetDesc: How many chat_id to pre-hang per account. Default 5.
settings.poolTtlDesc: chat_id older than this is discarded and rebuilt, avoiding silent upstream reclamation. Default 10.
settings.aliasesDesc: Model names sent by downstream are auto-routed by the gateway to the actual Qwen models below. Please edit in standard JSON format.

models.title: Models & Modes
models.subtitle: List of supported model identifiers and mode suffixes.
models.suffixDesc: You can append these suffixes to any Model ID to specify the operating mode.
